summary_1line: The monkeys reach the southern ocean while searching for Sita but become discouraged by the seemingly impassable sea until Angada begins to rally them.

image_candidates.scene_text: The monkey army stands on a cliff at the edge of the vast ocean, staring at the roaring waves stretching endlessly to the horizon.
The sea churns with towering waves and shadowy sea creatures as the monkeys recoil in awe and fear along the shore.
Prince Angada stands before the anxious monkey warriors on the beach, raising his hand as he urges them not to despair.
